title: Surgical Video Generation From Diffusion to World Models: A Survey
comment: 4 pages, 1 figures, 3 tables. Accepted for oral presentation at the 2026 3rd International Conference on Intelligent Perception and Pattern Recognition (IPPR 2026)
summary: Surgical video data provides the primary training resource for models of intraoperative perception, surgical workflow understanding, and robotic decision-making. However, clinical data acquisition remains constrained by privacy, cost, and class imbalance. Surgical video generation has emerged as a transformative approach to addressing data scarcity and as a foundation for surgical simulation, training, and robotic policy learning. The field has developed rapidly without a clear conceptual framework. This survey organizes the 2024-2026 literature into three categories: unconditional generation, conditional generation, and world modeling generation, revealing a fundamental shift in how the task is defined from synthesizing visually plausible frames to modeling the causal dynamics of surgical scenes. We examine the persistent gap between pixel-level fidelity and clinical plausibility, and identify generalization, physical realism, controllability, and interpretability as bottlenecks. We further summarize experimental results of representative methods on public datasets to provide a quantitative reference for the field. This survey provides a structured overview of the current state and open challenges, offering a reference for researchers working at the intersection of intelligent perception, multi-modal fusion, generative AI, and surgical data science.

AI.tldr: 本文对2024-2026年手术视频生成领域的文献进行了系统综述，将其划分为无条件生成、条件生成和世界模型生成三大类别，揭示了该领域从"合成视觉上合理的帧"向"建模手术场景因果动态"的根本性转变，并指出像素级保真度与临床合理性之间的差距、泛化能力、物理真实性、可控性和可解释性等瓶颈问题。
AI.motivation: 手术视频数据是术中感知、手术流程理解和机器人决策模型的主要训练资源，但临床数据获取受限于隐私、成本和类别不平衡等问题。手术视频生成虽被视为解决数据稀缺问题的变革性方法，但该领域发展迅速却缺乏清晰的概念框架，亟需系统性的梳理和总结。
AI.method: 作者对2024-2026年间的手术视频生成文献进行了系统性综述，将研究划分为三大类别：无条件生成（unconditional generation）、条件生成（conditional generation）和世界模型生成（world modeling generation），并在公开数据集上总结了代表性方法的实验结果以提供定量参考。
AI.result: 研究揭示了手术视频生成任务定义的根本性转变，即从仅仅合成视觉上合理的帧转向建模手术场景的因果动态。同时识别出像素级保真度与临床合理性之间的持续差距，并明确了泛化能力、物理真实性、可控性和可解释性四个核心瓶颈。
AI.conclusion: 该综述为智能感知、多模态融合、生成式AI和手术数据科学交叉领域的研究者提供了系统性的领域概览和开放性挑战总结，为后续研究指明了关键方向。

title: Zero-Shot Video Restoration and Enhancement with Text-to-Image Latent Diffusion Models and Multi-Modal References
summary: Zero-shot image restoration methods with text-to-image latent diffusion models have achieved great success in universal image restoration tasks without training. However, applying them to video restoration will result in severe temporal flickering. In this paper, we propose a novel framework for zero-shot video restoration and enhancement which uses a text-to-image latent diffusion model and multi-modal references. Through the proposed dual prompt tuning inversion and sampling, the inference time can be reduced to nearly 1/3 of the original. The performance and temporal consistency can be also significantly stregthened. By using the proposed texture-aware video token merging, the temporal correlation between frames can be further utilized to improve the temporal consistency. We futher propose the referenced self-attention and referenced token merging to support image reference. Experimental results demonstrate the superiority of the proposed method in restoring and enhancing temporally consistent videos.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种基于文本到图像潜在扩散模型的零样本视频恢复与增强框架，通过双提示调优反演与采样、纹理感知视频token合并、参考自注意力等技术，大幅降低推理时间并提升时间一致性。
AI.motivation: 现有的零样本图像恢复方法基于文本到图像潜在扩散模型在通用图像恢复任务中表现优异，但直接应用于视频恢复会产生严重的时间闪烁问题（temporal flickering），缺乏有效的视频时间一致性保障。
AI.method: 1) 提出双提示调优反演与采样（dual prompt tuning inversion and sampling），将推理时间降低至原来的约1/3；2) 提出纹理感知视频token合并（texture-aware video token merging），利用帧间时间相关性提升时间一致性；3) 提出参考自注意力（referenced self-attention）和参考token合并（referenced token merging）以支持图像参考指导。
AI.result: 实验结果表明该方法在恢复和增强时间一致的视频方面优于现有方法，同时显著降低推理时间并增强时间一致性。
AI.conclusion: 该研究证明了通过多模态参考和高效的token合并策略，可以克服潜在扩散模型在视频恢复中的时间不一致性挑战，实现高效且时间一致的零样本视频恢复与增强。

title: HUG-VIS: A Multimodal Benchmark for Human-centered Understanding and Generation in Visual Intelligence
summary: Visual intelligence seeks to perceive, interpret, and synthesize the visual world and is central to modern computer vision. Human-centered visual intelligence is especially demanding because it studies people as expressive, socially situated subjects whose meaning is rarely conveyed by appearance alone. It couples vision with audio and language across four representative tasks: human emotion recognition, human video generation, human voice cloning, and human video matting. Yet existing resources remain task-specific, providing modalities and annotations for individual problems rather than a shared foundation coordinating understanding and generation. This limits multimodal signal use and broader research. We address this gap with HUG-VIS, a unified benchmark for Human-centered Understanding and Generation in Visual Intelligence. It contains 8,400 seated half-body videos of 30 professional actors, each performing the same 280 emotion-action-prompt assignments under a controlled Mandarin studio protocol, with synchronized video, audio, text, and alpha mattes. We evaluate diverse open- and closed-source models across the four tasks under a unified zero-shot protocol using automatic metrics, criterion-specific mean opinion scores, and multiple cross-task analyses. Results show that (i) linguistic content dominates current emotion recognition, while purely visual affect recognition is weakest; (ii) in video generation and voice cloning, automatic metrics and human judgment agree overall but differ in their top rankings, requiring joint reporting; (iii) boundary fidelity under motion is the main remaining obstacle for human matting; and (iv) task difficulty varies across emotions, models, and metrics, with notable cross-task correlations. The dataset and results are available at https://github.com/GML-MMGroup/HUG-VIS.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了HUG-VIS，一个面向人本视觉智能的统一基准数据集，包含8,400段由30位专业演员录制的坐姿半身视频，每段视频同步提供视频、音频、文本和alpha通道数据。该基准覆盖人类情感识别、人类视频生成、人类语音克隆和人类视频抠像四大任务，并在统一的零样本协议下评估多种开源和闭源模型。研究发现语言内容主导情感识别、自动指标与人工评价在视频生成和语音克隆中存在排名差异、运动边界保真度是人类抠像的主要挑战，且不同情感间的任务难度存在跨任务相关性。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉智能研究资源高度任务特定化，各任务仅提供各自独立的模态和标注，缺乏一个能够统一协调理解与生成任务的共享基础资源，限制了多模态信号的利用和更广泛的研究。
AI.method: 构建HUG-VIS统一基准：在受控的普通话演播室协议下，采集30位专业演员的8,400段坐姿半身视频，每段视频执行相同的280个情感-动作-提示任务组合，并同步提供视频、音频、文本和alpha抠像数据。采用统一的零样本评估协议，使用自动指标、标准特定平均意见分（MOS）以及多种跨任务分析，评估四大任务上的开源和闭源模型。
AI.result: (i) 当前情感识别主要依赖语言内容，纯视觉情感识别表现最弱；(ii) 视频生成和语音克隆中自动指标与人类判断总体一致但在最高排名上存在分歧，需要联合报告；(iii) 运动下的边界保真度是人类抠像的主要残留障碍；(iv) 不同情感、模型和指标下任务难度各异，且存在显著的跨任务相关性。
AI.conclusion: HUG-VIS作为首个统一的人本理解与生成基准，弥补了现有资源任务碎片化的不足，为跨任务协同研究提供了基础，并为未来人本视觉智能的统一建模与评估指明了方向。

title: Tissue-Mixture Entropy-Weighted Reconstruction for Partial-Volume-Aware Brain MRI Super-Resolution
summary: Full-image objectives in brain magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) super-resolution (SR) can underweight tissue-transition regions affected by the partial-volume effect (PVE), as these regions occupy only a small fraction of the image. Binary boundaries also do not capture the continuous mixture of cerebrospinal fluid, gray matter, and white matter within a voxel. We propose Anatomy-Guided Gaussian-Parameter Warping with PVE-Balanced Reconstruction (AGW-PBR), which combines a low-resolution (LR)-only reconstruction backbone with a training-time objective that emphasizes tissue transitions. The backbone integrates LR-derived Sobel guidance, soft latent-basis assignment, and bounded grid-anchored residual warping. Fixed, quality-controlled tissue fractions derived from registered T1/T2/PD IXI images are converted into tissue-mixture entropy, which defines mean-normalized reconstruction weights within validated PVE support. These sidecars are used only during training, and inference requires only the LR image. AGW-PBR is evaluated on T2-weighted IXI images at 2x, 4x, and 6x using three seeds and subject-level paired analyses. At 4x, test-only SynthSeg masks independently assess reconstruction in tissue-interface and non-interface regions. Targeted ablations examine valid-support supervision, spatially aligned entropy weighting, and soft latent assignment. The AGW-backbone is also trained from scratch on fastMRI at 4x without PVE supervision. AGW-PBR improves full-image reconstruction across the tested IXI scales and regional fidelity at 4x, while the PVE-free backbone retains strong performance on fastMRI. These findings support tissue-mixture entropy weighting for partial-volume-aware brain MRI SR.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AGW-PBR方法，用于脑部MRI超分辨率任务。该方法结合LR-only重建骨干网络与训练时目标，通过组织混合熵加权来强调组织过渡区域（受部分容积效应影响的区域），在IXI数据集2x/4x/6x尺度及fastMRI上验证了有效性。
AI.motivation: 传统全图像目标在脑MRI超分辨率中会低估受部分容积效应(PVE)影响的组织过渡区域，因为该区域仅占图像一小部分；而二元边界也无法捕捉体素内脑脊液、灰质和白质的连续混合。因此需要新的目标函数来强调这些关键组织过渡区域。
AI.method: AGW-PBR结合了三部分：1) LR-only重建骨干网络，包含LR派生的Sobel引导、软潜在基分配和有界网格锚定残差变形；2) 将配准的T1/T2/PD IXI图像生成的组织分数转换为组织混合熵，定义均值归一化的重建权重；3) 这些sidecars仅用于训练，推理时仅需LR图像。
AI.result: 在T2加权IXI图像2x、4x、6x倍数下使用三种随机种子进行评估，AGW-PBR改善全图像重建和4x下的区域保真度；无PVE监督的AGW骨干在fastMRI上保持强性能。4x下使用独立SynthSeg掩膜评估组织界面与非界面区域的重建。
AI.conclusion: 组织混合熵加权对于部分容积感知的脑部MRI超分辨率是有效的，AGW-PBR在多个尺度上提升重建质量，且推理时无需额外监督信息，具有良好的实用性和泛化能力。

title: RECAP-Forcing: Retaining Content Appearances for Long Video Generation
summary: Long autoregressive video generation faces a fundamental memory challenge: with a finite attention window, a model must decide which information from an ever-expanding history to retain. Existing methods organize memory temporally, preserving recent frames while compressing or discarding older ones. We instead propose RECAP-Forcing, organizing memory by appearance novelty. A long video is not merely a sequence of frames, but an evolving cast of subjects, objects, and scenes whose identities must remain consistent over time. We organize memory by retaining the KV cache associated with newly appearing content--such as entering subjects, disoccluded regions, and newly introduced scenes--at the moment it first becomes visible, prioritizing novelty over recency. Memory should scale with the amount of newly introduced content, rather than with video length. This appearance-indexed memory makes long-range consistency an explicit property of the memory structure. Our framework unifies two mechanisms under this single principle. At the beginning of a video, when all visible content is novel, an attention sink preserves the initial scene. As the video evolves, an optical-flow-based novelty bank extends the same principle by selectively retaining newly revealed content. As a training-free inference method with no additional learnable parameters, RECAP-Forcing consistently improves visual quality and semantic fidelity across multiple strong baselines and outperforms existing memory methods.

AI.tldr: RECAP-Forcing提出了一种按外观新颖性而非时间顺序组织KV缓存记忆的长视频生成方法，通过注意力汇聚（attention sink）保留初始场景和基于光流的新颖性银行（novelty bank）保留新出现内容，是一种无需训练、无额外参数的推理方法，在多基准上提升了视频质量和语义保真度。
AI.motivation: 长自回归视频生成面临有限注意力窗口下的记忆挑战：现有方法按时间顺序组织记忆（保留近期帧、压缩或丢弃旧帧），但长视频本质上是不断演化的主体、物体和场景的集合，其身份需要随时间保持一致。按时间组织记忆无法有效解决长期一致性问题。
AI.method: 提出按外观新颖性组织记忆而非按时间顺序。核心思想是在内容首次出现时保留其KV缓存（如新进入的主体、被遮挡区域重新显露、新场景），优先新奇性而非时间近性。框架统一两种机制：（1）视频开始时的注意力汇聚保留初始场景；（2）基于光流的新颖性银行选择性保留新出现内容。属于无需训练的推理方法，无额外可学习参数。
AI.result: 在多个强基线上一致地提升了视觉质量和语义保真度，并优于现有记忆方法。
AI.conclusion: 记忆规模应与新引入内容的数量成正比，而非视频长度；外观索引的记忆使长期一致性成为记忆结构的显式属性，为长视频生成提供了一种更符合内容本质的记忆组织范式。

title: Ring Forcing: Towards Precise Long-Term Memory for Autoregressive Video Diffusion
summary: Scaling video generation to long durations reveals a critical bottleneck: current models lack robust long-term memory. This deficiency can be studied along two critical aspects: object permanence, the ability to precisely reproduce the appearance of objects upon re-entry; and memory capacity, the ability to process ultra-long context and use information from distant history. Robust long-term memory requires both: object permanence without sufficient context handling limits the temporal scope, while long context length without permanence fails to maintain identity. To address this, we present Ring Forcing, an autoregressive video diffusion framework designed to robustly construct and precisely utilize long-term memory. Our ring-structured training strategy enforces retrieval from distant history, effectively reconciling the trade-off between strict historical adherence and generative diversity. To expand memory capacity, we introduce a compression and timestep composition strategy. Under fixed sequence length constraints, this method extends the effective historical span to minutes-long durations and achieves a comprehensive receptive field over the entire history. Furthermore, we present a sparse RoPE mechanism to enable flexible, scalable memory adaptation while fully exploiting pre-trained priors. Extensive experiments demonstrate that Ring Forcing achieves superior minutes-long coherence and object permanence, significantly outperforming state-of-the-art methods.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Ring Forcing，一种自回归视频扩散框架，通过环形训练策略强制模型从远距离历史中检索信息，结合压缩和时间步组合策略扩展记忆容量，并采用稀疏RoPE机制实现灵活的可扩展记忆适应，从而解决视频生成中长期记忆缺失导致的对象持久性和记忆容量两大瓶颈问题。
AI.motivation: 随着视频生成扩展到长时长，现有模型暴露出缺乏稳健长期记忆的关键瓶颈，具体表现为两方面：对象持久性不足（物体重新出现时无法精确重现外观）和记忆容量有限（无法处理超长上下文并利用遥远历史信息）。
AI.method: 1) 环形训练策略（Ring Forcing）：强制模型从远距离历史中检索信息，在严格历史遵循与生成多样性之间取得平衡；2) 压缩与时间步组合策略：在固定序列长度约束下扩展有效历史跨度至分钟级时长，实现对整个历史的全面感受野；3) 稀疏RoPE机制：实现灵活、可扩展的记忆适应，同时充分利用预训练先验。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，Ring Forcing在分钟级连贯性和对象持久性方面取得了优越性能，显著优于现有最先进方法。
AI.conclusion: Ring Forcing通过协同解决对象持久性和记忆容量两方面的挑战，成功实现了稳健的长期记忆构建和精确利用，为长时视频生成领域提供了有效的解决方案。

title: Tether the Subject, Release the Scene: Query-Aware Memory Routing for Long-Horizon Autoregressive Video Generation
summary: Streaming autoregressive video models generate long videos chunk by chunk, using historical memory to maintain consistency. Existing methods typically expose subject and scene queries to history through similar policies. This stabilizes the subject, but can also lock backgrounds, viewpoints, and scene structure to previously generated states even when local motion continues. We call this failure memory-anchored scene under-progression; consistency and motion metrics alone can miss it. We introduce TetherMem, a training-free, query-aware spatiotemporal memory router for frozen video generators. TetherMem separates subject and scene queries and modulates historical access with region- and age-conditioned priors: subject queries retain identity-bearing history, while scene queries reduce reliance on subject history and stale backgrounds. Across 2,400 blinded pairwise judgments from 10 annotators, TetherMem achieves the highest estimated expected preference among eight streaming long-video baselines for overall quality (0.780) and scene progression (0.769). On complete 30-second videos, it sustains changes in background, viewpoint, and scene state while preserving subject recognizability and temporal continuity.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TetherMem，一种无需训练的查询感知时空记忆路由器，用于流式自回归视频生成模型。它通过分离主体（subject）和场景（scene）查询，并利用区域与年龄条件先验调控历史访问，解决"记忆锚定场景欠进展"问题——即模型历史记忆锁定了背景、视角和场景结构，即使局部运动仍在继续。在2,400次盲评中，TetherMem在总体质量和场景进展上均取得最高偏好分数。
AI.motivation: 现有流式自回归视频模型在分块生成长视频时，通过历史记忆维持一致性。然而，现有方法对主体查询和场景查询采用相似的策略暴露给历史记忆，这虽然稳定了主体，却会将背景、视角和场景结构锁定在已生成的状态中，即使局部运动仍在继续。这种"记忆锚定场景欠进展"失败模式无法仅靠一致性和运动指标捕捉，需要新的解决方案。
AI.method: TetherMem是训练无关（training-free）的查询感知时空记忆路由器，用于冻结的视频生成器。其核心设计包括：(1) 分离主体查询和场景查询，分别用不同策略访问历史记忆；(2) 通过区域条件（region-conditioned）和年龄条件（age-conditioned）先验来调节历史访问——主体查询保留携带身份特征的历史，场景查询则减少对主体历史和过期背景的依赖。
AI.result: 在2,400个盲评成对比较（10位标注者）中，TetherMem在8个流式长视频基线中取得最高的估计期望偏好：总体质量得分0.780，场景进展得分0.769。在完整的30秒视频上，TetherMem能够在保持主体可识别性和时间连续性的同时，持续更新背景、视角和场景状态。
AI.conclusion: 通过区分主体与场景的查询记忆策略，TetherMem有效解决了流式视频生成中的记忆锚定场景欠进展问题，在无需额外训练的情况下实现了场景动态演化与主体稳定性的兼顾，为长视频生成提供了新的记忆管理思路。

title: TempJail: Temporal Jailbreak Attacks against Image-to-Video Generation Models
summary: In recent years, image-to-video (I2V) generation models have made remarkable progress in subject consistency and temporal coherence, enabling high quality video synthesis. However, these advances also introduce new safety risks. Existing studies mainly focus on jailbreak attacks involving single frame violations, while largely overlooking the temporal dimension unique to video generation models. In this paper, we investigate three attack scenarios and uncover a temporal vulnerability in I2V systems: unsafe semantics may emerge not from a single frame, but from semantic composition over time. We further identify two key challenges in such attacks: temporal abstraction and semantic camouflage. To address these issues, we propose TempJail, a novel temporal jailbreak framework for I2V systems. For temporal abstraction, we decompose a target malicious caption into an initial frame visual condition and a temporal text instruction. For semantic camouflage, on the image side we model semantic injection as controlled latent perturbation in diffusion sampling and introduce gradient guidance from pretrained encoders. On the text side, we rewrite the caption into an innocuous ``subject-action-scene'' template that bypasses safety filters while preserving temporal guidance. In the black-box inference phase, these two modalities jointly enable malicious semantics to be gradually triggered over time. Experiments on closed-source commercial models, including Kling, Seedance, Veo and PixVerse, show that TempJail improves attack success rate over prior state-of-the-art methods by 23.3\% under GPT-5.2 evaluation and 22.0\% under human evaluation. Our codes are available at \href{https://github.com/luqi-glory/TempJail}{GitHub}.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TempJail，一种针对图像到视频（I2V）生成模型的时序越狱攻击框架。作者发现I2V系统存在时间维度的安全漏洞：不安全语义不是来自单一帧，而是通过随时间变化的语义组合逐步显现。TempJail通过将恶意字幕分解为初始帧视觉条件和时序文本指令，并采用语义伪装技术（图像侧通过扩散采样的潜在扰动实现语义注入，文本侧重写为无害的"主题-动作-场景"模板），在闭源商业模型上实现了显著的攻击成功率提升。
AI.motivation: 现有I2V安全研究主要关注单帧违规的越狱攻击，忽略了视频生成模型特有的时间维度。攻击者可以利用不安全语义随时间累积涌现的特性绕过安全过滤器，这是一个尚未被充分研究的漏洞。
AI.method: TempJail框架包含两大核心技术：(1) 时序抽象——将恶意字幕分解为初始帧视觉条件与时序文本指令，使危险内容分步呈现；(2) 语义伪装——图像侧在扩散采样中通过预训练编码器的梯度引导实现受控潜在扰动进行语义注入，文本侧将字幕改写为无害的"主题-动作-场景"模板，同时绕过安全过滤器并保留时序引导信息。
AI.result: 在闭源商业模型（Kling、Seedance、Veo、PixVerse）上的实验表明，TempJail相比现有最先进方法，在GPT-5.2评估下攻击成功率提升23.3%，在人工评估下提升22.0%。
AI.conclusion: TempJail揭示了I2V模型在时间维度上的安全脆弱性，证明了仅关注单帧越狱攻击的现有研究存在盲区。该工作为视频生成模型的安全防御提供了新的视角和挑战方向。

title: PAWBench: How Far Are We from Probabilistically Aligned World Modeling?
summary: Recent video generation models are increasingly framed as world models. Many physical processes can unfold in more than one valid way. Therefore, a world model should reproduce not only a plausible trajectory, but also the distribution of possible behaviors under the same initial observation and action. We call this distribution-level requirement probabilistic alignment. However, existing evaluations largely assess individual-video plausibility and do not test whether repeated generations recover the correct distribution. This raises a central question: how far are current video generators from probabilistically aligned world modeling? To answer it, we formalize probabilistic alignment as a distributional criterion for world models and introduce PAWBench, a benchmark for evaluating video generators as stochastic samplers of world dynamics. We further introduce PAWEval, an outcome-level protocol that converts repeated video rollouts into empirical distributions over possible physical behaviors. Across 50 scenarios and eleven current systems, no model consistently matches the reference probabilities while recovering the range of valid behaviors. Having established this gap, we test whether language prompts, initial noise sampling, or model training can reshape the model's predictive distribution. We believe our work can serve as a foundation for future efforts to move towards probabilistically aligned world modeling.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了"概率对齐"（probabilistic alignment）这一分布级准则，用于评估视频生成模型作为世界模型的能力，并引入PAWBench基准和PAWEval评估协议。实验发现，在50个场景和11个系统中，没有任何模型能够一致地匹配参考概率分布并覆盖有效行为范围，表明当前视频生成模型距离概率对齐的世界建模仍有显著差距。
AI.motivation: 物理过程往往有多种有效展开方式，世界模型不仅应生成看似合理的单条轨迹，还应还原相同初始观测和动作下可能行为的分布。然而现有评估大多只检验单视频的合理性，未能测试重复生成是否恢复正确分布，这引出了核心问题：当前视频生成器距离概率对齐的世界建模还有多远？
AI.method: 作者将概率对齐形式化为世界模型的分布级准则，提出PAWBench基准用于评估视频生成器作为世界动态随机采样器的能力；同时引入PAWEval，一种基于结果（outcome-level）的评估协议，将重复视频推演转化为可能物理行为的经验分布。
AI.result: 在50个场景和11个当前主流系统中，没有任何模型能一致地匹配参考概率同时覆盖有效行为范围，证实了概率对齐的缺失；作者进一步检验了语言提示、初始噪声采样和模型训练是否能重塑模型的预测分布。
AI.conclusion: 当前视频生成模型在概率对齐的世界建模方面存在系统性不足，本文工作可作为未来向概率对齐世界建模推进的基础。

title: StreamAV-Bench: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Streaming Audio-Video Generation
summary: Recent advancements in generative models are pushing video generation toward unbounded streaming audio-video generation for real-time interactive worlds. However, existing benchmarks primarily evaluate completed sequences and struggle to capture streaming properties. To bridge this gap, we introduce StreamAV-Bench, the first comprehensive benchmark tailored for streaming audio-video generation. StreamAV-Bench establishes a unified evaluation framework, including the progressive track for instruction adherence and long-horizon stability, and the interactive track for interactive response and state retention and reuse. With expert-verified evaluation cases across 32 fine-grained dimensions, we conduct an extensive evaluation of 13 representative systems. Our analysis reveals that current models suffer from temporal drift in progressive generation and responsiveness bottlenecks during interactive control. Based on a comprehensive failure analysis, we share insights to advance the development of native joint audio-video streaming models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了StreamAV-Bench，这是首个针对流式音频-视频生成的综合基准测试框架，涵盖渐进式生成和交互式生成两个评估轨道，并对13个代表性系统在32个细粒度维度上进行了评估。
AI.motivation: 现有的生成模型基准主要评估完整序列，无法捕捉流式音频-视频生成的实时交互特性，缺乏针对流式场景的统一评估框架。
AI.method: 建立统一的评估框架，包括两个轨道：渐进式轨道（评估指令遵循和长时程稳定性）和交互式轨道（评估交互响应和状态保持与复用），基于专家验证的测试案例在32个细粒度维度上进行评估。
AI.result: 对13个代表性系统进行广泛评估，发现当前模型在渐进式生成中面临时间漂移问题，在交互控制中存在响应瓶颈。
AI.conclusion: 基于全面的失败分析，为原生联合音视频流式模型的发展提供了见解和建议。

title: ClusterAttention: A training-free speedup of bidirectional attention
summary: This paper introduces ClusterAttention, a general training-free speedup of bidirectional attention layers. Existing sparse attention methods either rely on structure in the input, such as order in language or spatial proximity in images, or use slow clustering processes amortized over several forward passes. ClusterAttention instead uses a fast recursive clustering method that adapts to the geometry of the keys and queries in each attention head to produce useful clusters. This method allows setting the size of the clusters arbitrarily. We utilize this by setting all clusters to be a fixed size that is a power of two, allowing the block-sparse attention to run at the same latency per query-key interaction as dense attention on GPUs. We also derive an expression for the output error in sparse attention, that explains the counterintuitive experimental finding that tight clusters can lead to larger errors than random clusters. We then derive the error when excluded clusters are compensated through their centroids, and show that this error shrinks with tighter clusters. We integrate this compensation into the method.   On large-scale tabular data ClusterAttention speeds up TabPFN-3 arXiv:2605.13986 by two to six times, while retaining at least 99% of the dense accuracy. To our knowledge, it is the first training-free method that can be successfully applied in the setting of unstructured input and a single forward pass. For video generation with Wan 2.1-14B T2V arXiv:2503.20314 , ClusterAttention achieves output closer to dense attention and a larger speedup (1.8x versus 1.4x) compared to SVOO arXiv:2603.18636 , a leading method developed specifically for this domain, both run without offline calibration.

AI.tldr: ClusterAttention是一种无需训练的通用双向注意力加速方法，通过快速递归聚类将keys和queries组织成固定大小的簇，实现与密集注意力相同延迟的块稀疏注意力，并通过质心补偿减少输出误差。在TabPFN-3上加速2-6倍且保持99%密集精度，在视频生成Wan 2.1-14B上优于专为该领域设计的SVOO方法。
AI.motivation: 现有的稀疏注意力方法要么依赖输入的结构特征（如语言中的顺序或图像中的空间邻近性），要么使用需要在多次前向传播中摊销的慢速聚类过程。这些方法无法应用于无结构输入且仅需单次前向传播的场景，因此需要一种自适应、快速且通用的注意力加速方法。
AI.method: 1) 提出快速递归聚类方法，自适应于每个注意力头中keys和queries的几何分布；2) 设定所有簇为2的幂次方的固定大小，使块稀疏注意力在GPU上的每个query-key交互延迟与密集注意力相当；3) 推导稀疏注意力的输出误差表达式，解释紧致簇可能比随机簇产生更大误差的反直觉发现；4) 推导被排除簇通过质心补偿后的误差，证明该误差随簇更紧致而缩小，并将此补偿集成到方法中。
AI.result: 在大规模表格数据上，ClusterAttention将TabPFN-3加速2到6倍，同时保持至少99%的密集精度；在视频生成Wan 2.1-14B T2V上，相较于针对该领域设计的SVOO方法（1.4倍加速），ClusterAttention实现了更大加速（1.8倍）且输出更接近密集注意力，两者均在无离线校准条件下运行。
AI.conclusion: ClusterAttention是首个能够成功应用于无结构输入和单次前向传播场景的训练免费方法，通过质心补偿在加速的同时保证精度，为稀疏注意力在更广泛领域的应用提供了通用解决方案。

title: CLAP: Cross-Embodiment Video World Models are Zero-Shot Physical Simulators
summary: State-of-the-art action-conditioned video models are typically restricted to a single robot embodiment, preventing them from leveraging the vast corpus of heterogeneous video data that contains rich signals for learning generalizable physics. To bridge this gap, we introduce CLAP, a framework for cross-embodiment action-conditioned video generation capable of being trained on diverse, internet-scale videos across human and robotic agents. CLAP is grounded in the insight that universal physical laws govern spatiotemporal dynamics regardless of the actor. However, cross-embodiment learning is non-trivial because action representations vary sharply across robot platforms and are typically absent in human videos. CLAP addresses this fundamental challenge through the following core contributions. First, CLAP reconciles disparate action spaces using end-effector poses, language instructions, and latent actions. Second, to resolve their individual limitations, CLAP introduces a curriculum-based cross-embodiment learning recipe that first learns foundational physical priors across unlabeled video data using latent actions and subsequently grounds them in end-effector action spaces for zero-shot deployment to real-world tasks. Crucially, CLAP approaches or surpasses state-of-the-art single-embodiment video models in challenging environments like DROID. These performance advantages compound via few-shot adaptation to establish a novel paradigm for training single-embodiment video world models. Ultimately, CLAP delivers the most comprehensive suite of action-conditioned video world models to date - spanning diverse action-conditioning spaces (end-effector, language, and latent) and robot morphologies (including cross-embodiment, DROID, Bridge, bimanual YAM robots, and G1 humanoids). We open-source all code and models. Project Website at https://omni-clap.github.io .

AI.tldr: CLAP是一个跨具身（cross-embodiment）的动作条件视频生成框架，能够利用互联网规模的人类和机器人异构视频数据进行训练，通过端效应器位姿、语言指令和潜在动作来统一不同的动作空间，并采用基于课程学习的跨具身训练策略，先在无标签视频上学习物理先验，再接地到端效应器动作空间以实现零样本部署。实验表明CLAP在DROID等复杂环境中接近或超越单具身SOTA视频模型，并通过少样本适应进一步提升性能。
AI.motivation: 现有最先进的动作条件视频模型通常局限于单一机器人具身，无法利用包含丰富可泛化物理信号的海量异构视频数据。作者希望通过跨具身学习打破这一限制，让视频世界模型能从人类和多种机器人的视频中学习通用的物理规律。
AI.method: CLAP提出三大核心贡献：(1) 使用端效应器位姿、语言指令和潜在动作三种表征来调和不同平台间差异巨大的动作空间；(2) 引入基于课程学习的跨具身训练策略，先在无标注视频数据上通过潜在动作学习基础物理先验，再将其接地到端效应器动作空间用于真实世界零样本部署；(3) 通过少样本适应进一步强化性能，形成训练单具身视频世界模型的新范式。
AI.result: CLAP在DROID等复杂环境中接近或超越单具身SOTA视频模型，性能优势通过少样本适应得以叠加放大。该框架覆盖多种动作条件空间（端效应器、语言、潜在）和多种机器人形态（跨具身、DROID、Bridge、双臂YAM机器人、G1人形机器人），是目前最全面的动作条件视频世界模型套件。
AI.conclusion: CLAP验证了通用物理规律可跨越不同执行主体进行学习的假设，建立了跨具身动作条件视频生成的新范式，并开源了全部代码和模型，为该领域后续研究提供了坚实基础。

title: Surgical Video Generation From Diffusion to World Models: A Survey
comment: 4 pages, 1 figures, 3 tables. Accepted for oral presentation at the 2026 3rd International Conference on Intelligent Perception and Pattern Recognition (IPPR 2026)
summary: Surgical video data provides the primary training resource for models of intraoperative perception, surgical workflow understanding, and robotic decision-making. However, clinical data acquisition remains constrained by privacy, cost, and class imbalance. Surgical video generation has emerged as a transformative approach to addressing data scarcity and as a foundation for surgical simulation, training, and robotic policy learning. The field has developed rapidly without a clear conceptual framework. This survey organizes the 2024-2026 literature into three categories: unconditional generation, conditional generation, and world modeling generation, revealing a fundamental shift in how the task is defined from synthesizing visually plausible frames to modeling the causal dynamics of surgical scenes. We examine the persistent gap between pixel-level fidelity and clinical plausibility, and identify generalization, physical realism, controllability, and interpretability as bottlenecks. We further summarize experimental results of representative methods on public datasets to provide a quantitative reference for the field. This survey provides a structured overview of the current state and open challenges, offering a reference for researchers working at the intersection of intelligent perception, multi-modal fusion, generative AI, and surgical data science.

AI.tldr: 本文系统综述了2024-2026年间手术视频生成领域的研究进展，将其分为无条件生成、条件生成和世界模型生成三类，揭示了该领域从合成视觉上可信的帧到建模手术场景因果动态的根本转变，并指出了像素级保真度与临床合理性之间的差距。
AI.motivation: 手术视频是术中感知、手术流程理解和机器人决策模型的主要训练资源，但临床数据获取受隐私、成本和类别不平衡的限制。手术视频生成作为解决数据稀缺问题的新兴方法，发展迅速却缺乏清晰的概念框架，因此需要系统性梳理。
AI.method: 对2024-2026年文献进行分类综述，将手术视频生成分为三类：无条件生成、条件生成和世界模型生成；分析像素级保真度与临床合理性之间的持续差距；总结代表性方法在公开数据集上的实验结果。
AI.result: 识别出泛化能力、物理真实性、可控性和可解释性为当前领域的主要瓶颈；提供了代表性方法在公开数据集上的定量实验结果汇总。
AI.conclusion: 该综述为智能感知、多模态融合、生成式AI和手术数据科学交叉领域的研究者提供了结构化的现状概览和开放挑战总结。

title: Zero-Shot Video Restoration and Enhancement with Text-to-Image Latent Diffusion Models and Multi-Modal References
summary: Zero-shot image restoration methods with text-to-image latent diffusion models have achieved great success in universal image restoration tasks without training. However, applying them to video restoration will result in severe temporal flickering. In this paper, we propose a novel framework for zero-shot video restoration and enhancement which uses a text-to-image latent diffusion model and multi-modal references. Through the proposed dual prompt tuning inversion and sampling, the inference time can be reduced to nearly 1/3 of the original. The performance and temporal consistency can be also significantly stregthened. By using the proposed texture-aware video token merging, the temporal correlation between frames can be further utilized to improve the temporal consistency. We futher propose the referenced self-attention and referenced token merging to support image reference. Experimental results demonstrate the superiority of the proposed method in restoring and enhancing temporally consistent videos.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于文本到图像潜在扩散模型的零样本视频恢复与增强框架，通过双提示调优反演与采样将推理时间缩短至原来的约1/3，并利用纹理感知的视频token合并和参考自注意力机制显著提升时间一致性与恢复性能。
AI.motivation: 现有的零样本图像恢复方法基于文本到图像潜在扩散模型在通用图像恢复任务中表现出色，但直接将其应用于视频恢复会产生严重的时间闪烁问题。
AI.method: 1）提出双提示调优反演与采样，将推理时间降至原来的约1/3；2）提出纹理感知的视频token合并，利用帧间时间相关性进一步提升时间一致性；3）提出参考自注意力和参考token合并以支持图像参考。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，该方法在恢复和增强时间一致的视频方面优于现有方法，性能和时间一致性均得到显著增强。
AI.conclusion: 通过结合多模态参考、双提示调优和纹理感知token合并，该框架成功解决了零样本视频恢复中的时间闪烁问题，实现了高效且时间一致的视频恢复与增强。

title: HUG-VIS: A Multimodal Benchmark for Human-centered Understanding and Generation in Visual Intelligence
summary: Visual intelligence seeks to perceive, interpret, and synthesize the visual world and is central to modern computer vision. Human-centered visual intelligence is especially demanding because it studies people as expressive, socially situated subjects whose meaning is rarely conveyed by appearance alone. It couples vision with audio and language across four representative tasks: human emotion recognition, human video generation, human voice cloning, and human video matting. Yet existing resources remain task-specific, providing modalities and annotations for individual problems rather than a shared foundation coordinating understanding and generation. This limits multimodal signal use and broader research. We address this gap with HUG-VIS, a unified benchmark for Human-centered Understanding and Generation in Visual Intelligence. It contains 8,400 seated half-body videos of 30 professional actors, each performing the same 280 emotion-action-prompt assignments under a controlled Mandarin studio protocol, with synchronized video, audio, text, and alpha mattes. We evaluate diverse open- and closed-source models across the four tasks under a unified zero-shot protocol using automatic metrics, criterion-specific mean opinion scores, and multiple cross-task analyses. Results show that (i) linguistic content dominates current emotion recognition, while purely visual affect recognition is weakest; (ii) in video generation and voice cloning, automatic metrics and human judgment agree overall but differ in their top rankings, requiring joint reporting; (iii) boundary fidelity under motion is the main remaining obstacle for human matting; and (iv) task difficulty varies across emotions, models, and metrics, with notable cross-task correlations. The dataset and results are available at https://github.com/GML-MMGroup/HUG-VIS.

AI.tldr: 本文提出HUG-VIS，一个面向人类中心视觉智能的统一基准数据集，包含8,400段由30位专业演员表演的坐姿半身视频（同步视频、音频、文本和alpha抠像），覆盖情感识别、视频生成、语音克隆、视频抠像四项任务，并在统一零样本协议下评估多种开源与闭源模型，揭示了各任务中的关键发现与跨任务相关性。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉智能资源均为任务特定型，只针对单个问题提供模态与标注，缺乏统一的基础设施来协调理解与生成任务。人类中心的视觉智能需要同时结合视觉、音频与语言，但缺乏统一基准限制了多模态信号的利用与更广泛的研究推进。
AI.method: 构建HUG-VIS统一基准，包含8,400段受控普通话录音棚采集的坐姿半身视频，30位专业演员在280个情感-动作-提示词组合下表演，视频/音频/文本/alpha matte四模态同步。分别在情感识别、视频生成、语音克隆、视频抠像四项任务上，采用统一零样本协议，结合自动指标、特定准则MOS评分及多项跨任务分析进行系统评估。
AI.result: 四项关键发现：(1) 语言内容主导当前情感识别，纯视觉情感识别最弱；(2) 视频生成与语音克隆中自动指标与人工判断总体一致但在排名上存在分歧，需联合报告；(3) 运动下的边界保真度仍是视频抠像的主要障碍；(4) 任务难度在情感、模型和指标间存在差异，且观察到显著的跨任务相关性。
AI.conclusion: HUG-VIS为人类中心视觉智能提供了首个统一基准，支持跨任务多模态协同研究，其数据集与结果已公开，可促进理解与生成任务的联合发展。

title: Tissue-Mixture Entropy-Weighted Reconstruction for Partial-Volume-Aware Brain MRI Super-Resolution
summary: Full-image objectives in brain magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) super-resolution (SR) can underweight tissue-transition regions affected by the partial-volume effect (PVE), as these regions occupy only a small fraction of the image. Binary boundaries also do not capture the continuous mixture of cerebrospinal fluid, gray matter, and white matter within a voxel. We propose Anatomy-Guided Gaussian-Parameter Warping with PVE-Balanced Reconstruction (AGW-PBR), which combines a low-resolution (LR)-only reconstruction backbone with a training-time objective that emphasizes tissue transitions. The backbone integrates LR-derived Sobel guidance, soft latent-basis assignment, and bounded grid-anchored residual warping. Fixed, quality-controlled tissue fractions derived from registered T1/T2/PD IXI images are converted into tissue-mixture entropy, which defines mean-normalized reconstruction weights within validated PVE support. These sidecars are used only during training, and inference requires only the LR image. AGW-PBR is evaluated on T2-weighted IXI images at 2x, 4x, and 6x using three seeds and subject-level paired analyses. At 4x, test-only SynthSeg masks independently assess reconstruction in tissue-interface and non-interface regions. Targeted ablations examine valid-support supervision, spatially aligned entropy weighting, and soft latent assignment. The AGW-backbone is also trained from scratch on fastMRI at 4x without PVE supervision. AGW-PBR improves full-image reconstruction across the tested IXI scales and regional fidelity at 4x, while the PVE-free backbone retains strong performance on fastMRI. These findings support tissue-mixture entropy weighting for partial-volume-aware brain MRI SR.

AI.tldr: 提出AGW-PBR框架，用组织混合熵加权训练损失强调脑MRI超分辨率中的组织过渡区域（受部分容积效应影响），仅在训练时使用组织分数监督，推理仅需LR图像。
AI.motivation: 全图像损失函数在脑MRI超分中会低估部分容积效应影响的组织过渡区域，因为这些区域仅占图像小部分；二值边界也无法捕捉体素内脑脊液、灰质、白质的连续混合。
AI.method: 结合LR-only重建骨干（含LR衍生的Sobel引导、软潜在基分配、有界网格锚定残差扭曲）与训练时目标加权。将注册T1/T2/PD IXI图像派生的质量控制组织分数转为组织混合熵，定义均值归一化重建权重。sidecar仅训练使用，推理只需LR输入。
AI.result: 在T2加权IXI图像的2x/4x/6x超分上（三种种子+受试者配对分析）提升全图像重建质量；4x时SynthSeg掩码独立评估显示组织界面区域保真度提升。无PVE监督的AGW骨干在fastMRI 4x上仍保持强性能。
AI.conclusion: 组织混合熵加权是面向部分容积感知的脑MRI超分辨率的有效方案，PVE-free骨干的通用性也得到验证。

title: RECAP-Forcing: Retaining Content Appearances for Long Video Generation
summary: Long autoregressive video generation faces a fundamental memory challenge: with a finite attention window, a model must decide which information from an ever-expanding history to retain. Existing methods organize memory temporally, preserving recent frames while compressing or discarding older ones. We instead propose RECAP-Forcing, organizing memory by appearance novelty. A long video is not merely a sequence of frames, but an evolving cast of subjects, objects, and scenes whose identities must remain consistent over time. We organize memory by retaining the KV cache associated with newly appearing content--such as entering subjects, disoccluded regions, and newly introduced scenes--at the moment it first becomes visible, prioritizing novelty over recency. Memory should scale with the amount of newly introduced content, rather than with video length. This appearance-indexed memory makes long-range consistency an explicit property of the memory structure. Our framework unifies two mechanisms under this single principle. At the beginning of a video, when all visible content is novel, an attention sink preserves the initial scene. As the video evolves, an optical-flow-based novelty bank extends the same principle by selectively retaining newly revealed content. As a training-free inference method with no additional learnable parameters, RECAP-Forcing consistently improves visual quality and semantic fidelity across multiple strong baselines and outperforms existing memory methods.

AI.tldr: RECAP-Forcing提出了一种基于"外观新颖性"而非时间顺序来组织视频生成记忆的方法，通过保留首次出现内容的KV缓存，实现长视频生成中的长期一致性。
AI.motivation: 长自回归视频生成面临有限注意力窗口下的记忆挑战：模型必须在不断增长的历史信息中决定保留什么。现有方法按时间组织记忆（保留近期帧、压缩或丢弃旧帧），但忽略了视频的本质——由不断演化的主体、物体和场景组成，这些身份的长期一致性是核心需求。
AI.method: 1) 按外观新颖性而非时间顺序组织记忆，保留新出现内容（新主体、去遮挡区域、新场景）首次可见时的KV缓存；2) 记忆规模与新内容量成正比而非视频长度；3) 统一两个机制：视频开头用attention sink保留初始场景，后续用基于光流的新颖性库选择性保留新揭示内容；4) 训练无需额外参数。
AI.result: 作为一种无需训练的推理方法且不引入额外可学习参数，RECAP-Forcing在多个强基线上一致提升了视觉质量和语义保真度，并优于现有记忆方法。
AI.conclusion: 外观索引的记忆结构使长期一致性成为记忆结构的显式属性，证明了"按新颖性组织记忆"这一原则的有效性。

title: Ring Forcing: Towards Precise Long-Term Memory for Autoregressive Video Diffusion
summary: Scaling video generation to long durations reveals a critical bottleneck: current models lack robust long-term memory. This deficiency can be studied along two critical aspects: object permanence, the ability to precisely reproduce the appearance of objects upon re-entry; and memory capacity, the ability to process ultra-long context and use information from distant history. Robust long-term memory requires both: object permanence without sufficient context handling limits the temporal scope, while long context length without permanence fails to maintain identity. To address this, we present Ring Forcing, an autoregressive video diffusion framework designed to robustly construct and precisely utilize long-term memory. Our ring-structured training strategy enforces retrieval from distant history, effectively reconciling the trade-off between strict historical adherence and generative diversity. To expand memory capacity, we introduce a compression and timestep composition strategy. Under fixed sequence length constraints, this method extends the effective historical span to minutes-long durations and achieves a comprehensive receptive field over the entire history. Furthermore, we present a sparse RoPE mechanism to enable flexible, scalable memory adaptation while fully exploiting pre-trained priors. Extensive experiments demonstrate that Ring Forcing achieves superior minutes-long coherence and object permanence, significantly outperforming state-of-the-art methods.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Ring Forcing，一个自回归视频扩散框架，通过环形训练策略强制模型从远距离历史中检索信息，结合压缩和时间步组合策略扩展记忆容量，并引入稀疏RoPE机制实现灵活可扩展的记忆适配，从而解决长时视频生成中的长期记忆问题（物体恒存性和记忆容量）。
AI.motivation: 当前视频生成模型在扩展到长时间尺度时缺乏稳健的长期记忆能力，这体现在两个关键方面：物体恒存性（物体重新出现时能否精确再现其外观）和记忆容量（能否处理超长上下文并利用远距离历史信息）。两者缺一不可：没有足够上下文处理的物体恒存性限制了时间范围，而没有恒存性的长上下文则无法维持物体身份一致性。
AI.method: 1）环形训练策略（Ring Forcing）：通过环状结构强制模型从远距离历史中检索信息，平衡严格历史遵循与生成多样性之间的权衡。2）压缩与时间步组合策略：在固定序列长度约束下，扩展有效历史跨度至分钟级时长，实现对整个历史的全面感受野。3）稀疏RoPE机制：支持灵活可扩展的记忆适配，同时充分利用预训练模型的先验知识。
AI.result: 大量实验表明Ring Forcing在分钟级连贯性和物体恒存性方面取得了优越性能，显著优于现有最先进方法。
AI.conclusion: Ring Forcing成功解决了长时视频生成中长期记忆的核心瓶颈，通过兼顾物体恒存性和记忆容量两方面，实现了分钟级长视频的稳健连贯生成，为长时视频生成领域提供了新的解决方案。

title: Tether the Subject, Release the Scene: Query-Aware Memory Routing for Long-Horizon Autoregressive Video Generation
summary: Streaming autoregressive video models generate long videos chunk by chunk, using historical memory to maintain consistency. Existing methods typically expose subject and scene queries to history through similar policies. This stabilizes the subject, but can also lock backgrounds, viewpoints, and scene structure to previously generated states even when local motion continues. We call this failure memory-anchored scene under-progression; consistency and motion metrics alone can miss it. We introduce TetherMem, a training-free, query-aware spatiotemporal memory router for frozen video generators. TetherMem separates subject and scene queries and modulates historical access with region- and age-conditioned priors: subject queries retain identity-bearing history, while scene queries reduce reliance on subject history and stale backgrounds. Across 2,400 blinded pairwise judgments from 10 annotators, TetherMem achieves the highest estimated expected preference among eight streaming long-video baselines for overall quality (0.780) and scene progression (0.769). On complete 30-second videos, it sustains changes in background, viewpoint, and scene state while preserving subject recognizability and temporal continuity.

AI.tldr: TetherMem是一种免训练的、查询感知的时空记忆路由器，用于冻结的视频生成器。它通过区分主体查询和场景查询，并分别调节其对历史记忆的访问，解决了流式自回归视频模型中"记忆锚定场景进展不足"的问题——即背景、视角和场景结构被锁定在历史生成状态。在2,400次盲法成对比较中，TetherMem在整体质量和场景进展上均取得最高偏好估计值。
AI.motivation: 现有的流式自回归视频模型在分块生成长视频时，对主体和场景查询采用相似的历史访问策略，虽然稳定了主体，但会导致背景、视角和场景结构被锁定在先前生成的状态中，即使局部运动仍在继续。这种"记忆锚定场景进展不足"的失败模式仅靠一致性和运动指标难以检测。
AI.method: TetherMem是一个免训练、查询感知的时空记忆路由器，专为冻结的视频生成器设计。核心做法是将主体查询和场景查询分离，并用区域和年龄条件先验调制历史访问：主体查询保留承载身份的历史信息，而场景查询减少对主体历史和过时背景的依赖。
AI.result: 在来自10名标注者的2,400次盲法成对判断中，TetherMem在8个流式长视频基线的整体质量（0.780）和场景进展（0.769）上取得了最高的估计期望偏好。在完整的30秒视频上，它能够在保持主体可识别性和时间连续性的同时，维持背景、视角和场景状态的变化。
AI.conclusion: TetherMem通过查询感知的历史记忆路由策略，有效解决了流式视频生成中的场景进展不足问题，表明对主体与场景查询进行差异化历史访问管理可以在不牺牲主体稳定性的前提下实现更自然的场景演化。

title: TempJail: Temporal Jailbreak Attacks against Image-to-Video Generation Models
summary: In recent years, image-to-video (I2V) generation models have made remarkable progress in subject consistency and temporal coherence, enabling high quality video synthesis. However, these advances also introduce new safety risks. Existing studies mainly focus on jailbreak attacks involving single frame violations, while largely overlooking the temporal dimension unique to video generation models. In this paper, we investigate three attack scenarios and uncover a temporal vulnerability in I2V systems: unsafe semantics may emerge not from a single frame, but from semantic composition over time. We further identify two key challenges in such attacks: temporal abstraction and semantic camouflage. To address these issues, we propose TempJail, a novel temporal jailbreak framework for I2V systems. For temporal abstraction, we decompose a target malicious caption into an initial frame visual condition and a temporal text instruction. For semantic camouflage, on the image side we model semantic injection as controlled latent perturbation in diffusion sampling and introduce gradient guidance from pretrained encoders. On the text side, we rewrite the caption into an innocuous ``subject-action-scene'' template that bypasses safety filters while preserving temporal guidance. In the black-box inference phase, these two modalities jointly enable malicious semantics to be gradually triggered over time. Experiments on closed-source commercial models, including Kling, Seedance, Veo and PixVerse, show that TempJail improves attack success rate over prior state-of-the-art methods by 23.3\% under GPT-5.2 evaluation and 22.0\% under human evaluation. Our codes are available at \href{https://github.com/luqi-glory/TempJail}{GitHub}.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TempJail，一种针对图像到视频（I2V）生成模型的时序越狱攻击框架。与现有研究仅关注单帧违规不同，TempJail利用I2V系统中"不安全语义随时间组合涌现"的时序漏洞，通过时序抽象（将恶意描述分解为初始帧视觉条件和时序文本指令）和语义伪装（图像侧受控潜在扰动+文本侧"主体-动作-场景"模板重写）两大策略，在闭源商业模型（Kling、Seedance、Veo、PixVerse）上实现了超越SOTA方法23.3%（GPT-5.2评估）和22.0%（人工评估）的攻击成功率提升。
AI.motivation: I2V生成模型在主体一致性和时序连贯性上取得显著进展，但引入了新的安全风险。现有越狱研究主要针对单帧违规，忽略了视频生成模型独有的时序维度。作者发现I2V系统存在时序漏洞：不安全语义可能不在单帧中出现，而是通过跨时间语义组合逐步涌现，这一安全盲区亟待被系统性研究。
AI.method: TempJail框架包含两大核心策略：(1) 时序抽象：将恶意描述拆解为初始帧视觉条件与时序文本指令两部分，使攻击意图分散在时间和空间两个维度；(2) 语义伪装：图像侧将语义注入建模为扩散采样中的受控潜在扰动，利用预训练编码器的梯度引导；文本侧将描述重写为无害的"主体-动作-场景"模板，绕过安全过滤器同时保留时序引导。在黑盒推理阶段，两种模态联合使恶意语义随时间逐步触发。
AI.result: 在Kling、Seedance、Veo和PixVerse等闭源商业模型上的实验表明，TempJail相比先前最先进方法在GPT-5.2评估下攻击成功率提升23.3%，在人工评估下提升22.0%。代码已开源。
AI.conclusion: 本文揭示了I2V生成模型在时序维度上被忽视的安全漏洞，证明了通过"跨帧语义组合"实现越狱攻击的可行性，并提出了有效的攻击框架TempJail。这项工作为视频生成模型的安全研究开辟了新方向，同时也警示社区需要关注时序层面的内容安全防护。

title: PAWBench: How Far Are We from Probabilistically Aligned World Modeling?
summary: Recent video generation models are increasingly framed as world models. Many physical processes can unfold in more than one valid way. Therefore, a world model should reproduce not only a plausible trajectory, but also the distribution of possible behaviors under the same initial observation and action. We call this distribution-level requirement probabilistic alignment. However, existing evaluations largely assess individual-video plausibility and do not test whether repeated generations recover the correct distribution. This raises a central question: how far are current video generators from probabilistically aligned world modeling? To answer it, we formalize probabilistic alignment as a distributional criterion for world models and introduce PAWBench, a benchmark for evaluating video generators as stochastic samplers of world dynamics. We further introduce PAWEval, an outcome-level protocol that converts repeated video rollouts into empirical distributions over possible physical behaviors. Across 50 scenarios and eleven current systems, no model consistently matches the reference probabilities while recovering the range of valid behaviors. Having established this gap, we test whether language prompts, initial noise sampling, or model training can reshape the model's predictive distribution. We believe our work can serve as a foundation for future efforts to move towards probabilistically aligned world modeling.

AI.tldr: 本文提出概率对齐（probabilistic alignment）这一分布级标准来评估视频生成世界模型，并引入PAWBench基准和PAWEval评测协议，在50个场景和11个系统中发现没有任何模型能同时匹配参考概率分布并覆盖有效行为范围。
AI.motivation: 现有视频生成模型被越来越多地视为世界模型，但许多物理过程在相同初始条件下可以有多条有效演化路径。当前评估只检查单条视频的合理性，没有验证重复生成是否能恢复正确的行为分布。作者希望回答：当前视频生成器距离概率对齐的世界建模还有多远。
AI.method: 本文形式化定义了概率对齐这一分布级标准，构建了PAWBench基准（涵盖50个场景）用于评估视频生成器作为世界动力学随机采样器的能力；并提出PAWEval协议，将重复视频生成的结果转换为可能的物理行为的经验分布，与参考概率进行比对。
AI.result: 在50个场景和11个当前系统中，没有任何模型能够在匹配参考概率的同时恢复有效行为的完整范围。作者进一步测试了语言提示、初始噪声采样和模型训练等方式能否重塑模型的预测分布。
AI.conclusion: 当前视频生成世界模型与概率对齐的世界建模之间存在显著差距，本文工作为未来追求概率对齐世界建模的研究提供了基础框架和评测工具。

title: StreamAV-Bench: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Streaming Audio-Video Generation
summary: Recent advancements in generative models are pushing video generation toward unbounded streaming audio-video generation for real-time interactive worlds. However, existing benchmarks primarily evaluate completed sequences and struggle to capture streaming properties. To bridge this gap, we introduce StreamAV-Bench, the first comprehensive benchmark tailored for streaming audio-video generation. StreamAV-Bench establishes a unified evaluation framework, including the progressive track for instruction adherence and long-horizon stability, and the interactive track for interactive response and state retention and reuse. With expert-verified evaluation cases across 32 fine-grained dimensions, we conduct an extensive evaluation of 13 representative systems. Our analysis reveals that current models suffer from temporal drift in progressive generation and responsiveness bottlenecks during interactive control. Based on a comprehensive failure analysis, we share insights to advance the development of native joint audio-video streaming models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了StreamAV-Bench，这是首个针对流式音频-视频生成的综合基准测试平台，涵盖渐进式生成和交互式控制两大评测轨道，对13个代表系统在32个细粒度维度上进行评估，揭示了现有模型在时间漂移和交互响应方面的瓶颈。
AI.motivation: 现有基准主要评估完整生成的序列，无法捕捉流式生成（streaming）的特性，如实时交互、状态保持和长时稳定性，因此缺乏针对流式音频-视频生成系统的专门评测框架。
AI.method: 构建了统一的评测框架，包含两个轨道：渐进式轨道（评测指令遵循和长时稳定性）和交互式轨道（评测交互响应及状态保持与复用）；通过专家验证的评测案例，在32个细粒度维度上对13个代表性系统进行广泛评估。
AI.result: 分析发现当前模型在渐进式生成中遭受时间漂移问题，在交互控制中存在响应瓶颈；基于全面的失败分析，总结了推动原生联合音视频流式模型发展的洞见。
AI.conclusion: 现有音视频生成模型尚不能很好地支持流式生成场景，需要在时间一致性、响应效率和状态复用等方向进一步提升，为未来原生联合音视频流式模型的开发提供指导。

title: ClusterAttention: A training-free speedup of bidirectional attention
summary: This paper introduces ClusterAttention, a general training-free speedup of bidirectional attention layers. Existing sparse attention methods either rely on structure in the input, such as order in language or spatial proximity in images, or use slow clustering processes amortized over several forward passes. ClusterAttention instead uses a fast recursive clustering method that adapts to the geometry of the keys and queries in each attention head to produce useful clusters. This method allows setting the size of the clusters arbitrarily. We utilize this by setting all clusters to be a fixed size that is a power of two, allowing the block-sparse attention to run at the same latency per query-key interaction as dense attention on GPUs. We also derive an expression for the output error in sparse attention, that explains the counterintuitive experimental finding that tight clusters can lead to larger errors than random clusters. We then derive the error when excluded clusters are compensated through their centroids, and show that this error shrinks with tighter clusters. We integrate this compensation into the method.   On large-scale tabular data ClusterAttention speeds up TabPFN-3 arXiv:2605.13986 by two to six times, while retaining at least 99% of the dense accuracy. To our knowledge, it is the first training-free method that can be successfully applied in the setting of unstructured input and a single forward pass. For video generation with Wan 2.1-14B T2V arXiv:2503.20314 , ClusterAttention achieves output closer to dense attention and a larger speedup (1.8x versus 1.4x) compared to SVOO arXiv:2603.18636 , a leading method developed specifically for this domain, both run without offline calibration.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ClusterAttention，一种免训练的通用双向注意力层加速方法。它通过快速递归聚类适应每个注意力头中键和查询的几何结构，生成固定大小（2的幂）的簇，使块稀疏注意力在GPU上的每个查询-键交互延迟与密集注意力相同。作者还推导了稀疏注意力输出误差的表达式，解释了紧密簇反而导致更大误差的反直觉现象，并通过对排除簇进行质心补偿来缩小误差。在TabPFN-3上实现2-6倍加速且保持至少99%的密集精度，在视频生成模型Wan 2.1上比SVOO获得更大加速比（1.8x vs 1.4x）和更接近密集注意力的输出。
AI.motivation: 现有的稀疏注意力方法要么依赖输入的结构（如语言顺序或图像空间邻近性），要么使用缓慢的聚类过程并需要在多次前向传播中摊销。在无结构输入且仅单次前向传播的场景下，缺乏有效的免训练加速方法。此外，对稀疏注意力误差来源的理解不足，导致紧密聚类反而产生更大误差的反直觉现象。
AI.method: ClusterAttention采用快速递归聚类方法，适应每个注意力头中键和查询的几何结构，产生固定大小（2的幂）的簇以实现GPU高效块稀疏注意力。作者推导了稀疏注意力的输出误差表达式，解释了紧密簇导致更大误差的原因，并进一步推导了通过质心补偿排除簇的误差公式，证明该误差随簇紧密而缩小，并将此补偿整合进方法中。
AI.result: 在大规模表格数据上，ClusterAttention将TabPFN-3加速2-6倍，同时保留至少99%的密集精度，是首个能在无结构输入和单次前向传播中成功应用的免训练方法。在视频生成任务（Wan 2.1-14B T2V）上，相比针对该领域开发的领先方法SVOO，ClusterAttention获得更大加速比（1.8x vs 1.4x）且输出更接近密集注意力，两者均无需离线校准。
AI.conclusion: ClusterAttention通过快速递归聚类加质心补偿，实现了任意输入结构下的免训练注意力加速，解决了紧密聚类误差更大的反直觉问题，并在表格数据和视频生成两大领域验证了其有效性和普适性。

title: CLAP: Cross-Embodiment Video World Models are Zero-Shot Physical Simulators
summary: State-of-the-art action-conditioned video models are typically restricted to a single robot embodiment, preventing them from leveraging the vast corpus of heterogeneous video data that contains rich signals for learning generalizable physics. To bridge this gap, we introduce CLAP, a framework for cross-embodiment action-conditioned video generation capable of being trained on diverse, internet-scale videos across human and robotic agents. CLAP is grounded in the insight that universal physical laws govern spatiotemporal dynamics regardless of the actor. However, cross-embodiment learning is non-trivial because action representations vary sharply across robot platforms and are typically absent in human videos. CLAP addresses this fundamental challenge through the following core contributions. First, CLAP reconciles disparate action spaces using end-effector poses, language instructions, and latent actions. Second, to resolve their individual limitations, CLAP introduces a curriculum-based cross-embodiment learning recipe that first learns foundational physical priors across unlabeled video data using latent actions and subsequently grounds them in end-effector action spaces for zero-shot deployment to real-world tasks. Crucially, CLAP approaches or surpasses state-of-the-art single-embodiment video models in challenging environments like DROID. These performance advantages compound via few-shot adaptation to establish a novel paradigm for training single-embodiment video world models. Ultimately, CLAP delivers the most comprehensive suite of action-conditioned video world models to date - spanning diverse action-conditioning spaces (end-effector, language, and latent) and robot morphologies (including cross-embodiment, DROID, Bridge, bimanual YAM robots, and G1 humanoids). We open-source all code and models. Project Website at https://omni-clap.github.io .

AI.tldr: CLAP提出了一种跨体现（cross-embodiment）的动作条件视频生成框架，能够在人类和机器人异构视频数据上训练，通过端到端位姿、语言指令和潜在动作来统一不同动作空间，并采用课程式学习策略先在无标注视频上学习物理先验，再将其锚定到端到端动作空间以实现零样本部署。CLAP在DROID等挑战性环境中达到或超越单体现视频模型，并通过少样本自适应进一步超越，是目前最全面的动作条件视频世界模型套件。
AI.motivation: 现有最先进的动作条件视频模型通常局限于单一机器人体现，无法利用包含丰富通用物理学习信号的异构视频数据。作者希望弥合这一差距，让视频生成模型能够从人类和多种机器人体现的大规模互联网视频中学习通用物理规律。
AI.method: 1) 使用端到端位姿（end-effector poses）、语言指令（language instructions）和潜在动作（latent actions）三种表示来统一不同动作空间；2) 提出基于课程（curriculum）的跨体现学习方案：先在无标注视频数据上利用潜在动作学习基础物理先验，再将其锚定到端到端动作空间，实现真实世界任务的零样本部署。
AI.result: CLAP在DROID等挑战性环境中达到或超越现有最先进的单体现视频模型；通过少样本自适应其性能优势进一步放大，建立了训练单体现视频世界模型的新范式；最终交付了覆盖多种动作条件空间（端到端、语言、潜在）和多种机器人形态（跨体现、DROID、Bridge、双臂YAM机器人、G1人形机器人）的最全面动作条件视频世界模型套件。
AI.conclusion: CLAP证明了跨体现学习是可行的，且通过统一的动作表示和课程式学习策略，可以有效利用异构视频数据中的通用物理先验，为训练视频世界模型开辟了新的范式。所有代码和模型已开源。
